analysis.transcript_summary: The user confirmed an order for a black portable Bluetooth speaker. The agent requested and received additional address details (flat number and landmark). The agent offered a ₹50 discount for prepaid payment via UPI, but the user opted to keep the order as Cash on Delivery (COD). The agent confirmed the COD order and informed the user about free cancellation before dispatch. The conversation concluded with thanks.
